entries.title: Preserve early relay auth challenges
entries.rationale: Accept as security-gated relay authentication reliability hardening. Preserve ordered buffering before socket/auth waiter readiness, bounded frame memory, overflow failure, auth timeout/reset behavior, and reconnect isolation; verify no challenge or frame is processed under the wrong connection generation.
security_reasons: NIP-42 AUTH challenges can arrive before the client is ready to authenticate
frame ordering and connection-generation isolation protect the authentication boundary
bounded buffering prevents untrusted relay input from growing without limit
overflow and timeout must fail closed and reset the connection

tracking.implementation_plan: Adapted locally in c5c6f835124357472533dbe554fae90e3108aa37; MI8-22 tracks the later generic upstream contribution after the Zion adaptation is accepted.

verification: Tracked upstream SHA 6ea7a2b from PR #3320; MI8-22 tracks the later generic upstream contribution.

Implementation c5c6f835124357472533dbe554fae90e3108aa37 preserves ordered early AUTH handling and reconnect isolation while retaining the 256-frame limit, adding a 1 MiB aggregate limit for raw strings, native text frames, and native binary arrays, and failing closed on unsizeable frames.
Focused checks passed: relayInboundBuffer.test.mjs (5 tests); pnpm test:e2e:smoke -- relay-reconnect.spec.ts (7 tests); RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 just test (9 groups, all passed).
